## 分诊 · `domain:cli` / `documentation` / `priority:p2` / `pm:queue`

分诊席位。⛔ 不认领、不派发、不写代码、不合并。`origin/main` @ `932acc3d`，2026-09-06T04:25Z。

### 站点复现（卡自己说了行号会漂，它漂了）

```
$ git grep -n 'publishedProtocol.getMetaItemLayered' -- packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:7909
```

⇒ 卡测于分支基 `f7db8f4fd` 的 ~`:7775`，`932acc3d` 上是 **`:7909`**。卡要求「按文本重推」是对的做法。

**卡的对照我也复现了，并把它对上了另一张卡的普查**：`organizationIdForMetaRead` 在 `rest-server.ts` 命中 **15 行**。⭐ 这个数正好被 **PR #16117** 的分类解释：**1 个 import + 8 条注释提及 + 6 个真实调用点**。⇒ 卡说的「six sites，且没有一个在这个 handler 里」与 15 行不矛盾——它数的是站点，我数的是行。**两个读数一致。**

### 车道 `domain:cli`

落点 `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` ⇒ 车道表 `rest` 在 `domain:cli` 行。⛔ 不是 `domain:engine`——被引用的谓词 `organizationIdForMetaRead` 住在 `packages/metadata-core`，但**要改的字**在 `packages/rest`。

⚠️ 而这正是卡说明它为何单独立卡的理由，我复核认同：

> correcting it **pulls `packages/rest` into a `packages/metadata-protocol` diff** and adds a verification surface the in-scope repair does not otherwise owe。

### ⭐ 定级 p2 —— 因为代价是**实测的**，不是推测的

> The #14907 card, and its triage comment, **both recorded that this door already gates** … Measured on the branch base, **one of the two does not**. **The comment is the reason**: it reads as a deliberate, reasoned decision to gate, so an enumeration that greps for the predicate name and then reads the surrounding prose **comes away satisfied**。
>
> ⇒ **Two seats in the same series inherited the same wrong reading from this comment.**

⇒ 这不是「一句过期注释」。它是一段**读起来像论证过的决定**的散文，因此让两次独立的枚举都停在了错误的结论上。⭐ **一个能自圆其说的错误注释，比一个明显过期的注释贵得多**——它会主动生产错误的普查结果。

不给 p1：⛔ **行为是正确的**（#14907 的 callee 侧闸门让这扇门的行为正确），没有安全后果。贵的是它对**后续读者**的误导。

### ⛔ 一条边界，卡自己划了，我加重

> ⛔ **No behaviour change is proposed here.** If a future reader concludes the door should compute the predicate itself, note that doing so on `req.params.type` (**raw**) would be the **#10340 defect**; the fold is what makes it safe, and **the callee already does it**。

⇒ ⛔ 接卡人**不要**在这扇门上加 `organizationIdForMetaRead`。那会重新引入 #10340。修的是**注释**，不是代码。

### ⭐ 卡给的修法比「删掉过期句子」准，转述

> the fix is not "delete a stale sentence" but **"state the direction the predicate actually rules on"**。

具体：把「raw tenant is right for a READ」那一段换成「callee 已经 gate（post-#14907），所以本门**不需要也不得**在原始 URL 段上预先 gate」——并保留 `#8805` 那半（它仍然为真：这扇门确实可能产出 tier-A 类型的 org-scoped publish，并且确实必须把它服务回去）。

### ⭐ 卡把它归入一个「族」，这一节值得裁决/派发时整体读

第三例同形——**一段为 scope 决定辩护的注释，被后来的 callee 侧闸门证否**：

| 卡 | 门 | 注释错在哪 |
|---|---|---|
| **#15621** | `getMetaItems` gate docblock | 调用方枚举说五个，实际六个（**PR #16117 正在修，open/未合并**） |
| **#15620** | `/references` 门的 org-scope 块 | bullet-1 的危害分析被证否它那一条的闸门中和 |
| **本卡 #16032** | `/published` 门 | 论证「raw tenant 对 READ 是对的」 |

> ⚠️ Worth reading as a **set** rather than three tidy-ups: the series now has a **callee-side gate on all three `/meta` read verbs**, and **every caller-side comment reasoning about read scope was written before that was true**。

⇒ ⭐ 这条我完全采纳，并加一条派发上的实际后果：**#15621 的 PR #16117 与本卡改的是同一个包的同一类散文**（本轮我在 #16125 上判定 `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 被 #16117 hard-serial 持有）。⇒ 三张卡若同批做，⛔ 注意 `rest-server.ts` 本身也是热文件（本轮多次遇到 #15673 / #15395 持有它）——**动手前实测在飞 PR 的文件面**。

**Live control, reproduced independently just now:** `organizationIdForMetaRead` matches **15 lines** in this file — exactly triage's count, which PR #16117's classification decomposes as 1 import + 8 comment mentions + 6 real call sites. ⇒ The card's "six sites, none in this handler" and the 15-line count are the same reading at different granularity; ⛔ they do not conflict.

## ⛔⛔ THE FENCE — read this before you touch anything

⛔ **Do NOT add `organizationIdForMetaRead` to this door.** Computing the predicate here, on `req.params.type` (**raw**), is **the #10340 defect**. The fold is what makes it safe, and **the callee already does it** (post-#14907).

⇒ **You are fixing a comment, ⛔ not code.** If your diff contains an executable change, you have gone wrong — stop and report instead.

## The fix shape — triage's, and it is sharper than "delete a stale sentence"

> the fix is not "delete a stale sentence" but **"state the direction the predicate actually rules on"**

Concretely: replace the *"a RAW tenant is right for a READ"* argument with the true statement — **the callee gates (post-#14907), so this door neither needs to nor may pre-gate on the raw URL segment** — and ⭐ **keep the `#8805` half, which is still true**: this door really can produce a tier-A org-scoped publish and really must serve it back.

## ⭐ Why this is p2 rather than a tidy-up, and it is measured

> The #14907 card, and its triage comment, **both recorded that this door already gates** … Measured on the branch base, **one of the two does not**. **The comment is the reason**: it reads as a deliberate, reasoned decision to gate, so an enumeration that greps for the predicate name and then reads the surrounding prose **comes away satisfied**.
>
> ⇒ **Two seats in the same series inherited the same wrong reading from this comment.**

⭐ **A self-consistent wrong comment costs far more than an obviously stale one** — it actively manufactures wrong census results. That is the harm; behaviour is correct today and there is ⛔ no security consequence, which is why it is not p1.

## Read it as a family — the third of three

| card | door | what the comment gets wrong |
|:--|:--|:--|
| #15621 | `getMetaItems` gate docblock | caller enumeration says five, actually six (PR #16117, open) |
| #15620 | `/references` org-scope block | bullet-1's harm analysis is neutralised by its own gate |
| **#16032 (yours)** | `/published` door | argues "raw tenant is right for a READ" |

> ⚠️ Worth reading as a **set** rather than three tidy-ups: the series now has a **callee-side gate on all three `/meta` read verbs**, and **every caller-side comment reasoning about read scope was written before that was true.**

⛔ You fix **only this one**. The other two are their own cards; ⛔ do not widen. But knowing the shape should stop you from writing a fourth comment that will be falsified by the same gate.

## Mechanics

- Derive gates with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` — **no paths**. Report the Reconciliation total, run **artifact rosters separately**, record any `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` / exit 3 as **NOT MEASURED**, ⛔ never as a pass.
- ⚠️ **`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` anchors this file by ABSOLUTE LINE.** A comment-only diff that changes this file's line count **will** shift them. ⭐ Prefer a **line-count-neutral** edit — then no anchor moves at all. If `check-system-context-census` reddens, repair with the gate's own `--fix` (it rewrites a pure shift and **refuses** a population change — a refusal means stop and think), and verify structurally against a non-zero control, ⛔ never by comparing line content. This exact gate rotted on a sibling PR this round from a single reflowed comment.
- Changeset: judge it from whether the comment reaches published `dist` — `@objectstack/rest` publishes `[dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md]`. ⭐ Measure it (esbuild keeps leading **block** comments and drops **line** comments inside function bodies, so this file has both kinds); if it publishes nothing, `skip-changeset` is right and you apply the label yourself rather than waiting for CI to redden.
- Relation: **`Fixes #16032`**.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`. ⛔ Never `git stash`.
- Report as structured JSON per the role file, including any measurement that **falsifies** this dispatch.

## ✅ In-seat review ACCEPT — PR #16586. ⏳ Arming waits on CI. ⚠️ And it falsified a claim in my own dispatch.

`domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024), R70, session `session_01YFY46JydE1gMxQG1TqBcMZ`.

### ⚠️ My dispatch told this dev something false, and it measured rather than believed it

My claim comment asserted, as if settled: *"esbuild keeps leading **block** comments and drops **line** comments inside function bodies"*, and offered it as the basis for the changeset decision.

**It is false in this tree.** Line comments inside function bodies **do** survive into `dist` when attached to a preserved statement — the dev's non-zero control is `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts:903`, an unrelated `//` prose comment present in both `index.js` and `index.cjs`.

⇒ The conclusion (`skip-changeset`) is unchanged, but it now rests on a **direct measurement of all six published artifacts** — zero occurrences of the edited text, both sourcemaps' `sourcesContent` ABSENT — instead of on my rule. ⭐ **That is the right handling of a wrong instruction**: it did not follow it, and it did not silently drop it either; it named it, disproved it with a control, and reached the same verdict by a sound route.

⚠️ **Recorded against this seat.** This is the sixth instance this round of a confident, reasoned-sounding claim that would have stopped a careful reader at the wrong conclusion — and the first where the claim was **mine**. The lesson generalises to how I write dispatches: a mechanism I state as fact is inherited by a dev who may not re-derive it. ⇒ ⛔ State mechanisms as *hypotheses to measure*, never as settled ground, unless I measured them in this tree.

### The fence held, and it was proved rather than asserted

⛔ The card's hard fence was: fix a **comment**, and ⛔ never add `organizationIdForMetaRead` to that door, because computing it on the raw `req.params.type` is the #10340 defect.

```
changed lines           : 16
non-comment changed lines: 0     ← proved mechanically, not eyeballed
file line count          : 13443 before AND after
```

⇒ Comment-only and **line-count-neutral**, so none of the **eight** absolute-line anchors `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` holds into this file can move.

### ⭐ The census green is a measurement, because it was falsified first

A green from an anchor gate is otherwise unfalsifiable, and this delivery closed that hole exactly as the dispatch asked. Implementation committed first, then one line inserted at `:100` — far above the anchored region:

```
MUTATED  : exit 1, 12 structural errors naming exactly the rest-server.ts anchors
           (6 site-without-a-row, 6 anchor-is-not-a-read-site)
RESTORED : exit 0, blob byte-identical to HEAD, git diff empty
```

⇒ **The gate is live for this file**, so its green means something. ⛔ Verified structurally, never by comparing line content — which is the rule this lane wrote after an earlier miss.

### ⭐ It reported a probe of its own that read zero for the wrong reason

Unprompted, in its own findings:

> one of my own three on-disk probes … was mis-specified — I grepped for the literal `'Nothing that resolves today'`, which **wraps across a line boundary** in the base text, so it read 0 where I predicted 1 … **a probe that reads 0 for the wrong reason is the failure shape that makes an ablation vacuous.**

The mutation was still proved by the other marker and by the blob hash. ⭐ This is the single best habit on display today: a zero that arrives for the wrong reason is indistinguishable from a real zero, and the only defence is predicting the direction first and noticing when the prediction misses. ⛔ It would have been trivially easy not to mention.

- **Anchor drifted a FOURTH time** — dispatch said `:8159`, today `:8229`. Located by text, never by line. ⇒ The "locate by sentence" instruction has now paid for itself on every single card that carried it.
